name: Hephaestus
description: A zone-control support who deploys 3 mechanical devices at battle start, activating them one per Ultimate cast to build toward a field-wide Fusion effect. Anchored to his Forge, he gains unlimited range and damage reduction in exchange for total immobility.

skills.name: Ultimate Domain
skills.description: Passive: At the start of battle, summons 3 inactive mechanical devices onto the field. Active: Activates the farthest device, expanding its area of effect. Allies inside recover HP and Energy per second; enemies inside have ATK Power and ATK Speed reduced. When all 3 devices are active, they merge into a single field-wide device -- immediately reducing all enemies' damage rate and boosting friendly damage rate and ATK Speed. Subsequent casts also trigger this Fusion effect.

upgrades.level2: HP and Energy recovered per second by allies inside activated devices increased.
upgrades.level3: ATK Power and ATK Speed reduction on enemies inside devices increased.
upgrades.level4: Fusion effect amplified: greater enemy damage rate reduction and higher friendly damage rate and ATK Speed boost.

skills.name: Weak Point Analysis
skills.description: Fires a laser at the enemy currently dealing the most damage, binding them for a duration. Each active device on the field extends the Bind duration by a set amount. Also reduces the target's Physical and Magical resistance.

upgrades.level2: Physical and Magical resistance reduction increased.
upgrades.level3: Bind duration extension per active field device increased.
upgrades.level4: Physical and Magical resistance reduction increased again.

skills.name: Force Field Shield
skills.description: Heals the most wounded allied unit and reduces the damage they receive for a duration. For each active device on the field, the damage reduction effect is additionally increased by a percentage.

upgrades.level3: Damage reduction from active field devices increased.

skills.name: Source Resonance
skills.description: Hephaestus's Energy recovery speed is increased by a percentage.

upgrades.level2: Energy recovery rate increase is higher.
upgrades.level3: Energy recovery rate increase is higher again.
upgrades.level4: Gains initial Energy at the start of battle.

relic.name: Undying Forge
relic.description: At the start of battle, places a Forge in front of Hephaestus. If he moves away, he is teleported back and put in an intercepted state. While at the Forge, Hephaestus enters Focus state: unlimited attack range and reduced damage taken.

upgrades.level2: In Focus state: cooldowns of Weak Point Analysis and Force Field Shield reduced.
upgrades.level3: In Focus state: Energy cost to cast Ultimate Domain reduced.
upgrades.level4: In Focus state: damage taken further reduced.
